items.evidence: Log lines 3-83: block set to 4 C with lid open, then 1 uL aspirated from each plasmid well A1-H1 and dispensed into the matching transformation_plate well.
Log 84-87: lid closed, 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s, then 4 C for 2 min, all on the thermocycler.
Log 90-169: 50 uL SOC from soc_reservoir A1 dispensed into each of A1-H1 after heat shock; log 170-171: lid closed, 37 C for 60 min.
Each of 8 P20 additions and 8 P300 additions has its own pick up and drop tip (log 4-83, 90-169); SOC is aspirated before the tip touches cells, and no tip is reused.

Volumes (1/10/50 uL), times and temperatures match the paper's LV config. The 2 min post-shock 4 C step and 37 C lid setpoint are disclosed in comments and are reasonable choices; the metadata citation is accurate.

judge.summary: The run log shows a faithful LV APEX Protocol 1: 1 uL DNA into 10 uL cells at 4 C, 30 min at 4 C, 30 s at 42 C with the lid closed, 50 uL SOC, then 1 h at 37 C. Fresh tips were used throughout, and the added gentle mixing and 37 C lid setpoint are disclosed and reasonable.
